data.name: Ghazzal
data.long_meaning: In Islamic lore, Ghazzal refers to the amoeba of light. It is believed that this creature was created from the light of God's revelation during the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) miraculous night journey to Jerusalem and then to the heavens. Ghazzal symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and closeness to the divine.
